ruling.recommended_action: Refund $2.98 (voucher per NS-7) to the rider for the one unexempted off-route segment and log the driver's RD-1 shortest-route breach on file.

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment 18:53–19:01 adds 2.11 km (up to 995 m from optimal route). Driver cited a breakdown [F8] but the traffic record supporting it (F11: ECP breakdown at 18:27, coordinates near Airport Boulevard) is not shown to lie on the replaced optimal-route segment, and F9/F10 are only speed band 4, which under RD-4(b) cannot exempt alone. No pre-deviation chat consent [F7], so RD-5 does not apply. Segment remains unexempted under RD-1/RD-4(c).

rejected_claims.reason: RD-4(a) requires the traffic incident to corroborate the replaced optimal-route segment; the ECP breakdown record [F11] is not matched to that segment, and band-4 speed records [F9][F10] are only corroborative under RD-4(b), not standalone exemptions.
RD-2 refunds only the unexempted segment's extra distance (2.11 km × $1.41 = $2.98); the ~0.29 km residual between fare-excess [F4] and segment sums is map-matching noise and is not refundable.
